verdict.rationale:
Gitea docs explicitly claim universal OS/architecture compatibility (Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Kubernetes, x86/arm64) and easy deployment without complex dependencies, and community reports corroborate real-world deployment via Docker containers and on low-resource VPS/hardware. Minor gap: no independent benchmark of every listed OS/arch combination beyond community anecdotes.

missing for 10: independent verification across all claimed OS/architecture combinations, more detail on official container image support.
